sources.observation: The Latvian bank homepage identifies this exact SVG as its header SEB logo. The original vector is a black SEB lettermark with vertical separators on a white square field, with no separate bank-name caption; its geometry is native paths in the official-served SVG. The page and SVG were retrieved separately over HTTPS. The pinned icon instead has white lettering on light-green circle.

SEB Latvia's 26 March 2026 announcement says its light-green website and internet-bank logo would be replaced with the classic black-and-white logo, and that its mobile app icon had changed to dark green while retaining the SEB logo and Latvian flag. The live homepage shows the black-and-white version now. This is an explicitly channel-specific difference, not evidence that all green SEB marks are retired.
